items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: His son is a concert pianist right now. I don't know where he's playing, because I don't keep up with Classical music.

ctx.x: But he has a son, you say...

His son is a concert pianist right now. I don't know where he's playing, because I don't keep up with Classical music. But Blanchard, I don't know if he ever come back to New York or not. I never heard nobody say anything about him.
Then you went back to Russell, and this now was a different band altogether from his earlier bands.
